agents.note: US-511 debounced parked signal -- PASSES. A pure reducer parkedInit/parkedNext({parked,raw,sinceMs}) now sits between carouselIdle and the kebab policy: parked needs idle held true >= parkedOnS (8 s), and reverts only after idle false >= parkedOffS (3 s). Asymmetric on purpose -- slow to OFFER a single tap into a service stop, fast to WITHDRAW it once the car moves -- and pinned behaviourally, not as a comparison of two constants. THE ONE STRUCTURAL CALL FOR THE PM: I changed menuAccess's SIGNATURE to menuAccess(parked). It used to take the system-status payload and call carouselIdle itself, so an upstream debounce was bypassable by the next edit for free; AC-2 says the kebab keys off 'parked' NOT raw idle, and putting the raw flag out of reach is the only way that holds. The footgun this creates is closed: an un-migrated caller would pass an OBJECT and a truthy test would read it as parked FOREVER (kebab pinned on screen at 70 mph), so the test is a strict `parked === true` and a raw payload fails closed. Three honesty guards on the derived hold, all mutation-proved: re-anchor-don't-accumulate (six 2 s blips never sum to one 3 s run); an unreadable clock returns the state COMPLETELY untouched (recording a reading without a timestamp lets the next real clock credit this run's time to the previous reading); a negative hold (NTP step back, no RTC on this Pi) re-anchors rather than stranding the signal for the size of the step. TDD 28/30 RED-first; after committing green I mutation-proved 7 defects (kebab always visible / long-press gated / debounce bypassed / hold reset every tick / accumulate / negative-hold guard dropped / loose slicer) -- all 7 RED, both mutated files verified identical to HEAD after. Re-aimed two overturned pre-existing pins (the six US-490 menuAccess fixtures moved one link upstream to carouselIdle, keeping the fail-closed invariant; the poll-applies pin's call text gained nowMs). ROUTED TO PM, no TD filed: tests/ui/test_carousel_nav_model.py's _fnBody slices at a FIXED 4-space indent, but carousel.js declares pure logic at 2-space -- so a 2-space function's 'body' runs on to the DOM block. That is what made my own absence pin go red against correct code (4th occurrence of the greps-a-defect's-name family). I fixed MY copy to be indent-aware and pinned the slicer at BOTH edges (over-stripping makes an absence assertion pass vacuously); the loose helpers elsewhere are untouched per scope fence but are worth a housekeeping sweep. Scope fence held: updateHomeNav still edge-triggers on RAW idle -- a nav jump wants the real edge, and AC-2 names the kebab only. Green in-loop: tests/ui + tests/deploy/test_dashboard_kit.py = 549 passed exit 0; tests/pi/splash 179/1 skipped; ruff clean; validate_config passes. Architecture DoD met in-sprint. NEXT: sprint 68 is otherwise COMPLETE -- only US-510 remains passes:false, blocked on BL-027 (Iris's woff2 base64), which is a PM/CIO decision, not codeable work. PRIOR SESSION (US-510) fidelity pass -- CLOSED passes:false, and the reason is NARROW: A-1 (locked copy) and A-2 (token sweep, both Atlas Rule-10 rulings applied) shipped COMPLETE and green; A-3 shipped its structural half (--font-display in the SSOT + mirrored + bound to exactly the wordmark and card titles). The one gap is an EXTERNAL ASSET: AC A-3 requires an inlined @font-face woff2 data-URI and no font file exists in the repo (verified by repo-wide search; Marcus's own groom note to Iris still asks her to drop the base64). Locked face is Bahnschrift -- Microsoft-bundled, not redistributable, absent from Pi OS -- so naming it does not put it on the panel. Did NOT fabricate font base64 and did NOT substitute a face (CIO pick, Iris's lane). Filed BL-027 with a ~30-min fast-follow recipe; PM owes the call on whether US-510 closes as-is. Also filed TD-071 for the one bounded exception (~12 #fff/#000 CONTRAST PAIRS on tiered chips/ribbon/takeover -- naming them needs Iris's vocabulary + an Atlas token addition; the whole-file guard allows exactly those two short forms so the debt cannot grow) plus SSOT promotion of the three --*-deep gradient-edge tokens.
